qualification: negative local A05.3 evidence; the candidate is not retained and does not qualify A05.3, G1-G5, or a release

candidate.attemptedBoundary: An append-only context word let every generated memory-bearing block select its own restartable-read policy on entry, including after a raw direct or indirect link. The runtime target filter then admitted multi-access blocks as well as the separately accepted single-access class.
candidate.focusedResult: A two-read chained-target regression passed in baseline and tier-one modes, including a second-read decline, exact prefix recovery, preserved destination state, and one dispatcher entry.
candidate.productionFailure: The frozen fixture reached /init but soft-locked PID 395 in unmap_page_range during execve, emitted no authenticated workload receipt, and exhausted the full one-billion-instruction budget.

verification.targeted: The ABI, metadata, direct multi-access chain, and existing restartable-read tests passed.
verification.deterministicAggregate: 1,554 tests in 179 suites passed with test parallelism disabled before the production run.
verification.productionDisposition: Rejected despite unit and aggregate success because the pinned production safety gate is authoritative.

disposition.nextBoundary: Retain accepted single-access target chaining. Separate read-only multi-access targets from read-modify/write and stack-memory targets before another production widening.

limitations: The terminal sample establishes a soft lockup but not the exact corrupting instruction or first divergent state.
The experiment widened all restartable multi-access targets together, so it does not distinguish read-only blocks from read-modify/write or stack-memory blocks.
The measured dispatcher share is failure-run telemetry and is not a performance acceptance result.
